plugin.name: Install the enemy potion distribution plugin
plugin.description:
Adds "Zenderal - Enemy Potions.esp".
Enemies in Enderal almost never carry potions - the game's potion lists sit on townsfolk and on corpse props, not on anything that fights back. This plugin gives bandits of every tier and the Lost Ones a level-appropriate health, mana or stamina potion roughly one kill in three, on top of the loot they already drop.
Potion tiers scale with your level: rancid and cheap potions early, standard from level 20, quality from 30, exclusive from 40.
NOTHING IS REMOVED. The three leveled lists it touches are restructured so their original contents resolve exactly as before, with the potion roll added independently alongside them.
LOAD ORDER: this plugin must load AFTER any mod that changes enemy loot or leveled lists. It overrides "00E_MOB_Bandit", "_00E_FS_DeathItem_Human" and "DeathItemDraugr"; if another loot mod touches those, the later plugin wins and one of the two changes is lost.
No scripts, no new assets, ESL-flagged - it costs no load-order slot and is safe to add to an existing save. Removing it mid-playthrough is also safe; already-generated corpses keep whatever they rolled.
